patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality product photography dominates sections, often with minimal, precisely placed text overlays.
A consistent monospaced or highly geometric sans-serif typeface is used for almost all text, from small uppercase labels to main headings, creating a technical and precise brand voice.
A dark mode aesthetic with a dominant black or very dark grey background, contrasted with white or light grey text, allowing product imagery to provide the primary color accents.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the main product image scrolls slower than the background and text, creating depth.
Sections reveal with a gentle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery.
Product carousels are used for 'latest articles' and other product showcases, featuring large, clean product shots with minimal text.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll: an initial transparent top bar disappears, and the main logo/menu bar shrinks slightly in height while gaining a solid dark background, remaining sticky at the top.
Hero imagery is implemented with a subtle parallax effect, where the main subject moves at a slower rate than the scroll, creating a sense of depth against the background.
Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations (likely AOS), where elements fade in and slide up slightly as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, precise, and often uppercase text for labels and subheadings, with main headings being moderately sized, maintaining a consistent, almost technical feel across all text elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks and within the hero section, balanced by more compact product grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a monospaced-like typeface for almost all text, from headings to body, combined with a dark, minimalist aesthetic and large, high-quality product photography, creates a unique blend of technical precision and high-fashion luxury. The subtle, controlled scroll animations enhance this sophisticated feel without being distracting.
